Demand for Insurance

Compare two versions of life in one picture: sick and healthy. Insurance is a promise that fattens your share in the bad case.

At a fair premium, covering the bad case completely is best. Both cases end up holding the same 💰 money. Add a loading to the premium and the math changes. Covering only part of the loss becomes the smarter deal.

For example, 30 🧑 classmates each chip in 100 won every month. When someone gets hurt, the pot helps pay the hospital bill. If nobody gets hurt, the 100 won is simply gone. Still, the hurt friend is spared a scary bill.
